single.label: Find a path for a single arrow
single.observed: Forward is local to the current heading, which changes after movement.
single.construct: Fix the end pose first and turn before the last leg. Offer a route with a matching position but wrong facing or one that assumed a fixed basis. Compare both final pose components.

fleet-path.label: Choose a program connecting two boards
fleet-path.observed: An addressed cell selects its current arrow; landing on an occupied cell exchanges two occupants.
fleet-path.construct: Use a swap followed by another move from an affected coordinate. A foil carries the old color or heading; compare every cell after complete replay.

fleet-state.label: Choose the resulting board
fleet-state.observed: Each legal command updates the whole colored, oriented board.
fleet-state.construct: Hold the path fixed. Offer boards differing at the displaced arrow, not only at the mover. Vary starting cells and command order while preserving a visible difference.

checkpoint.label: Disambiguate paths at an intermediate pose
checkpoint.observed: Endpoint and heading constrain the final pose in the official single-arrow paths.
checkpoint.construct: Make two paths share that pose but differ after step one. Show the checkpoint; dropping it should allow the competing route.
checkpoint.extension: Showing a checkpoint to distinguish convergent paths is a harness extension.

predecessor.label: Recover a starting pose
predecessor.observed: The final pose reflects all relative turns and step lengths.
predecessor.construct: Fix the program and end pose. Offer legal initial poses, including a start that works only in a fixed frame. Replay each from its own initial facing.
predecessor.extension: Reversing the endpoint task to ask for a predecessor is a harness extension.
